alt: Real ChatGPT /matchinggame execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /matchinggame Using only the attached chapter, build an interactive three-pair matching game linking training, inference and context to their definitions. Include feedback and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Select Training as the concept to match.
Match it to the definition involving prediction error and parameter updates.
Select Inference for the second pair.
Match Inference to running a model with existing parameters.
Select Context for the final pair.
Match Context to the information available during the current inference.
Inspect the completed three-pair result and number of attempts.
Restart the board to practise the pairs again.
Select Training again in the fresh board.
Inspect the new round at one of three pairs completed.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
